Included JSON files are extracts from the Overpass API. They retain geographic geometry and tags used to construct the 3D view. Retrieval timestamps are included in each file.

Destination photography: Unsplash, https://unsplash.com/license
Photo IDs and download URLs are recorded in scripts/fetch-assets.mjs in the source repository.
